test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some flowers are buds.

Some flowers are trees.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are buds.

II. No tree is a bud.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some flowers are buds.

Some flowers are trees.

Conclusions:

The least possible Venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6900f4344417d3e7dc950259f29b42dfe49cac049858bdc8b48c959f1764a36.png] 

I. Some trees are buds - **False **(Because, there is no direct relation is given between trees are buds, so it can be possible only). 

II. No tree is a bud - False (Because, there is no direct relation is given between trees are buds, so it can be possible only).

Thus, neither conclusion I nor II follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
